Text.Page:
[EN] Leander and his brother Elleon brought us here to discover the secrets of the island. Now only Leander remains, and we must bury those who learned them.
[ES] Leander y su hermano Elleon nos trajeron aquí para descubrir los secretos de la isla. Ahora solo queda Leander, y debemos enterrar a quienes los aprendieron.
